description: This shell script is a test file for a Git-related test suite. It contains a series of test cases that set up repositories, perform Git operations like merge, reset, and cherry-pick, and verify the state of the repository after these operations. The tests focus on behaviors related to unmerged entries, conflict resolution, and specific Git commands such as read-tree, reset, merge, and am.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository with a specified name.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a given filename.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, setting up conditions and verifying outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path is missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands to run after a test completes.
